title: Sales Room: Real Platform Screenshots Brief
summary: Exactly which live Corner platform screenshots to capture for sales assets, which shots are non-negotiable, and what features to avoid until fixed.
content:
Sales Room: Real Platform Screenshots Brief

Author: Steve (Sales Director) Date: 2026-03-23 Rule: No mockups. No future-state. Real product only. "Not hype shit, shit that makes you say I need that."

What Exists Right Now (Confirmed Shipped)

Based on Bobby's tape and commit history, these features are live in production:

Game Layer

  • Hex grid with pixel art agent rooms (Elon, Gary, Bobby confirmed live as super agents)
  • Isometric Three.js background (Crossy Road grass + sky, day/night cycle)
  • Rooms light up when agents are active
  • Day = vibrant blue glass HUD, Night = dark blue
  • AOM badge world switcher dropdown (portal-escaped, opens below badge)

Bottom HUD / Right Now Bar (RNB)

  • Colored pills: fuchsia (queued), orange (active), yellow (review), green (flash on complete), red (stuck)
  • Per-agent dedup (only newest task per agent)
  • Realtime from Supabase events table -- sub-1-second updates when agents write events
  • Three super agents (Elon, Gary, Bobby) all writing to Ledger

Chat

  • Agent-colored bubbles (each agent has own color)
  • Typing indicators with personality phases: green 0-30s ("On it"), yellow 30-120s ("lemme cook bro"), red 120s+ ("This is taking longer than expected")
  • Typewriter animation on typing indicators
  • Reply-to message threading
  • Real relay -- not a ChatGPT API wrapper. Actual tmux agent on the other side

Sidebar / Panels

  • Four tabs: Chat, List, Info, Files
  • UnifiedPanel (desktop/iPad), MobileDrawer (iPhone)
  • Task pills with priority bars and note indicators
  • Trello board view (BoardView.jsx) with context menus

Navigation

  • Game/Board toggle top-right (fixed, not scrollable)
  • AOM badge world switcher (multi-tenant: your world, client worlds, Create World)
  • Project pills in nav bar
  • FAB button with room creation modal

Security / Auth

  • S1-S3 gates shipped: auth bypass removed, /onboarding route fixed, DEFAULT_PROJECTS scoped to AOM only
  • Supabase auth. Real multi-tenant isolation in production

Onboarding

  • 5-step wizard live at /onboarding
  • Room creation modal (CreateRoomModal -- 635 lines, solid build)

The 5 Core Sales Shots

These are the non-negotiable visuals every sales asset needs. Capture them from the live dashboard at aom-studio.vercel.app/dashboard.

Shot 1: The Office Overview

What: Full game viewport. Three super agent rooms visible (Elon, Gary, Bobby). RNB active with colored pills. Day mode (vibrant blue). Why it sells: This is the "I need that" moment. Nobody else has built a business tool that looks like a game. First visual impression in every demo, every LinkedIn clip, /corner hero. State to capture: All three agents showing tasks in RNB. At minimum 3 colored pills. Day mode for maximum visual impact. File: corner-office-full.png

Shot 2: Bobby's Room -- Agent in Action

What: Bobby's room selected. Chat panel open. Real message thread with Bobby's colored bubbles. Typing indicator active (yellow/green phase). Why it sells: Proves it's a real agent, not a chatbot. The personality phrases ("lemme cook bro" in yellow) make prospects laugh and want it. State to capture: Genuine Bobby conversation from Patrik. Use the real "oh shit is this big Bobby?" thread if it exists in chat history. File: corner-bobby-chat.png

Shot 3: RNB Close-Up -- Live Task Pills

What: Bottom HUD zoomed/cropped to show the colored pill system clearly. Fuchsia + orange + yellow all visible simultaneously. Why it sells: Three different colors = three agents doing different things = the team is real and active. This is the visual proof of "24/7 AI operations team." State to capture: Run Bobby's Ledger battle test or trigger real agent activity so pills have actual colors. File: corner-rnb-pills.png

Shot 4: World Switcher Open

What: AOM badge dropdown open. Shows "AOM" as current world. Clean dark background, worlds list with at least one client world listed. Why it sells: Multi-tenant in one screenshot. "You can manage all your clients from here" without any explanation. State to capture: Populate at least one test world in Supabase so the list isn't empty. File: corner-world-switcher.png

Shot 5: Checklist with Done Tasks

What: List tab open. Mix of completed tasks (checked off, strikethrough) and active tasks. Real task names from AOM's actual work queue. Why it sells: This is the "real business runs on this" proof. Seeing "Wire Bobby's room to events table -- DONE" next to "Ship S1-S3 -- DONE" tells prospects this isn't a toy. State to capture: Patrik's actual task list for AOM. Don't sanitize it -- real task names land harder than generic ones. File: corner-checklist-done.png

Bonus: The Super Agent Triangle Video

Elon confirmed Bobby can capture animated content directly from React + Framer Motion via Playwright video.

The sequence to record:

  1. Three super agents appear in RNB simultaneously (fuchsia pills -- queued)
  2. One by one, pills go orange (active)
  3. Bobby's room lights up as he starts a task
  4. Chat bubble appears in Bobby's room
  5. Task completes -- green flash, pill clears
  6. RNB returns to calm

Total length: 15-20 seconds. Loop perfectly. This is the hero video for /corner, LinkedIn ads, the one-pager header.

How to capture: Bobby + Playwright via Elon. The battle test sequence he already built (4 agents, staggered lifecycle) is the template. Record it as MP4. Trim to 15s loop.

File: corner-super-agents-demo.mp4

What's NOT Ready for Screenshots

These features exist in code but have confirmed issues that would look bad in a sales screenshot:

  • RNB at half drawer on iPhone -- cut off, currently STILL BROKEN (pain #1)
  • Input box position -- still broken per 41 pains (#2)
  • Drag and drop -- Trello ghost card glitches (#8) -- don't record on camera
  • Right-click menus -- exist visually but not wired to actions (#9)
  • Mark's room -- Mark has no room yet (#30)
  • White backgrounds -- keep appearing in AOM expand menu (#4)

For sales screenshots: use the game viewport and RNB on desktop/iPad only. Do not screenshot the Trello board drag, right-click menus, or iOS half-drawer until those are confirmed fixed.

Deployment

Asset Destination
corner-office-full.png /corner hero, demo script slide 1, one-pager header
corner-bobby-chat.png Demo slide 2, LinkedIn post image
corner-rnb-pills.png Demo slide 3, /corner "how it works" section
corner-world-switcher.png Demo slide 4, one-pager footer, /corner multi-tenant section
corner-checklist-done.png Demo slide 5, pilot mode pitch slide
corner-super-agents-demo.mp4 /corner hero video, LinkedIn video post, demo screen-share opener

Steffen should receive all 6 assets for layout integration into the /corner redesign.
